description: This file defines classes and methods for generating and validating NZP-CSI-RS signals, including sequence generation, CDM application, and configuration validation, within a 3GPP-compliant wireless communication system.

classes.name: nzp_csi_rs_configuration_validator_impl
classes.description: Implements validation for NZP-CSI-RS generator configuration.

classes.name: nzp_csi_rs_generator_impl
classes.description: Implements NZP-CSI-RS signal generation, including sequence creation and CDM application.

methods.name: generate_sequence
methods.description: Generates the NZP-CSI-RS sequence for a given symbol and configuration.

methods.name: apply_cdm
methods.description: Applies CDM codes to the NZP-CSI-RS sequence.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Maps the generated sequence onto the resource grid.
